steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Context: The Elizabethan era was a great age of exploration. Improvements in navigation, shipbuilding, and cartography made long ocean voyages possible. English explorers were driven by a combination of economic ambition, national rivalry with Spain, religious zeal, and sheer curiosity.
